answer_1.quote: ...We present a framework that evaluates the effectiveness of LLM-generated mirror stories... We release MIRRORSTORIES, a corpus of 1,500 personalized short stories generated by integrating elements such as name, gender, age, ethnicity, reader interest, and moral of the story...

answer_2.quote: ...We calculated cosine similarity using Word2Vec embeddings... The average cosine similarity was 0.12 for the provided interest and 0.27 for the moral... Table 2: The Shannon Diversity Index (SDI) values for all story types...

answer_3.quote: ...GPT-4 (ver. 0613) was used as an evaluator in both experiments. Initially, it assessed the integration of personalized elements. Later, it was used to evaluate the stories for satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness...

answer_4.quote: ...the same 26 human evaluators-all students from diverse disciplines-were tasked with evaluating the narratives... They provided feedback on all three story types, rating them on satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness...
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators answered a structured questionnaire rating each story on satisfaction, quality, engagement, personalness, and moral identification.
